text:
incident-bot: ALERT > hosted.api.us-east queue length spiked to 23k, p95=2.4s p99=12.1s, 504 rate 6.2% — paging kevin-oncall :rotating_light:
kevin-oncall: on it, joining VC. first pass: check autoscaler and GPU pool saturation
omar-sre: looks like provisioner is hitting a soft limit on instance creation (rate-limited). logs show repeated 429s from cloud quota API and `provisioner` stuck in PendingProvision state
lisa-ml: model-serving pools are saturated for `redwood-gpt-medium` — KV cache objects queued, many requests are falling back to the slow path
kevin-oncall: key question — is autoscaler failing or is cloud throttling?
omar-sre: both. autoscaler attempted to expand from 40->80 but cloud returned quota errors. provisioner then retried rapidly and hit internal backoff; backlog grew while retries looped
sophie-support: customers reporting timeouts across Hosted API. ticket flood from top-tier customers is starting (3 active high-priority). Need ETA for mitigation for impacted tenants
nina-product: which customers are hit? prioritize enterprise accounts so we can do manual routing if needed
kevin-oncall: list coming, but short-term mitigation ideas:
- flip traffic for enterprise customers to `dedicated-fallback` pool (manual route)
- temporarily lower non-critical tenant priority via per-tenant rate-limits
- increase autoscaler max if cloud quota OK, or request quota bump via infra escalation
- enable degraded model variant (quantized) for cheaper capacity
omar-sre: trying manual scale commands now (`infractl provision gpu --pool dedicated-fallback --count 16`) — if that fails, we'll failover routes instead
deploy-bot: deploy started: route-update v2026.03.17-quick-fallback -> applying
kevin-oncall: running `kubectl get pods -n serving | grep redwood-gpt-medium` — many pods in `ContainerCreating` and `ImagePullBackOff`
lisa-ml: ImagePullBackOff appears related to registry rate limit for the quantized image tag; switching to cached local image could help
omar-sre: docs show cloud provider returning 429: "Quota exceeded: instances per project". opened cloud support ticket (CS-1829) and requested emergency quota increase, ETA unknown
kevin-oncall: Sophie — can you message the top three customers with a short note? Say we're mitigating and offer to route their traffic to Dedicated if they want immediate relief
sophie-support: DMing customers now, template: "We're aware of increased latencies/503s, we're actively routing enterprise traffic to reserved capacity. ETA ~15-30m for mitigation."
nina-product: approve prioritized routing for those accounts. Please capture which keys we move so we can audit later
kevin-oncall: Omar, try bumping autoscaler max to 120 temporarily and trigger a slow ramp while we wait for quota? Might not pass but worth a try
omar-sre: running `infractl autoscaler update --name hosted-gpu --max 120 --ramp 5m` — response: Accepted locally, but provisioner still errors on cloud create. Local config updated though
kevin-oncall: OK, manual routing step for enterprise keys: `route-manage move-keys --from hosted --to dedicated-fallback --keys customerA,customerB,customerC` — please run and confirm
omar-sre: Ran it for customerA and customerB, routes now pointing to dedicated pool. Observed immediate drop in their 504s. customerC has session pinning; need to drain first
lisa-ml: enabling degraded model variant for public traffic: `modelctl serve --model redwood-gpt-medium-quant --pool hosted` — expect lower throughput per GPU but helps reduce tail latency for many small requests
ina-product: good. track quality impact — set a short eval on sample prompts for customer C to ensure acceptable responses
kevin-oncall: Observability: queue dropped from 23k -> 9.2k after routing two customers. p95 for customerA dropped to 0.8s. Global p99 still high at ~9s
sophie-support: customers A/B acknowledged and appreciate the quick action. still fielding messages for others
omar-sre: cloud support responded: provisional quota increase approved for 30 more instances in region; ETA ~20 minutes for provisioning confirmations
kevin-oncall: timeline: manual routing + degraded model gave ~50% queue decrease. next step: when quota shows in provider, trigger controlled autoscale to consume new instances and drain backlog
lisa-ml: small note — enabling quantized variant increases token generation time ~10% for some prompts; acceptable tradeoff for latency improvement here
kevin-oncall: ongoing: keep per-tenant throttles in effect for non-enterprise. Post-incident: root cause: provisioner retries exacerbated cloud quota blocking and caused a feedback loop. Action items created
kevin-oncall: ACTIONS:
- omar-sre: add exponential backoff and jitter to provisioner retries (ticket INFRA-3487)
- omar-sre: add proactive cloud quota monitoring and preemptive bump automation (INFRA-3490)
- lisa-ml: add quicker failover path to quantized model artifact in serving config (SERVE-122)
- product/sa: prep comms for affected customers summarizing mitigation
- support: follow-up for impacted customers and attach event timeline
kevin-oncall: anyone else?
sophie-support: will queue the support follow-ups and attach message IDs
nina-product: I'll coordinate comms with CS and legal if needed
kevin-oncall: wrapping up here. We'll keep thread open for status. current metrics at 10m post-mitigation: queue=7.9k p95=1.1s p99=7.2s 504=1.8%
incident-bot: Incident updated -> status: mitigation in progress. responders: kevin-oncall, omar-sre, lisa-ml
kevin-oncall: thanks team. I'll follow up with a short postmortem draft once stable. Closing VC now. :thumbsup:
